original_drop_helper.name: crate::root_authority_session::tests::drop_original_production_after_idle
original_drop_helper.input: Consumes actual AgentdRootProductionInputs; clones only the same private LiveRoot and original worker AbortHandle for observation.
original_drop_helper.preconditions: Within one original TIMEOUT, acquire the original serial permit; reject prior sticky refresh failure, finished worker or any original live.current() error; execute before_drop under the same permit; check failure/worker state again.
original_drop_helper.action: Actually drop the whole original production inputs. Existing session Drop fences the original cache and aborts the original worker. Keep the permit while waiting boundedly for that same worker to finish.
original_drop_helper.completion: AbortHandle is only an original termination witness after the intentional actual Drop, not evidence that a refresh succeeded. Any earlier failure, callback failure, timeout or original authority error remains a test failure.
original_drop_helper.no_deadlock_argument: The entire original refresh, including final read, runs under this semaphore. With the permit held, the worker is idle or awaiting the permit and cannot own in-flight refresh I/O. Its cancellation requires no permit acquisition. The new sticky witness prevents classifying a prior Err/cancellation released just before worker exit as a deliberate shutdown.

closed_resource_proof.proof: prepare_feature(self, authorities, selected, target) and recover_feature(self, ...) consume all actual original capability inputs. PreparedRootInitialFeatureV1::publish(self, signed) also consumes itself. There is no retained separate Initial client in the child after these calls.

The original Initial client moves into the actual Current owner, and actual target files enter the original journal. Those owners travel into the prepared/ready result and finally the task, or are dropped on original error.

Consuming Drop of complete inputs releases the original session, cognitive/checkpoint transport, Device/Notes consumers and grant provider. The one-shot connection was already moved into the consumed Initial handoff/client.

The helper's remaining LiveRoot clone is read-only and cannot retain the original registered writer File. It waits for the original worker's complete future/custody cleanup before releasing its permit.

Every branch has explicit actual capability disposal before CLOSED. Retired task remains only through its negative assertion, then is explicitly dropped. Remaining bundle/plan/identity/claims values are data, not purpose clients or original transport owners.

The registration thread returns after CLOSED, without waiting for PHASE_COMPLETE. The main thread joins it and checks the unchanged served success/refusal branch before sending PHASE_COMPLETE. Child waits with no purpose clients, preventing a child-waits-parent/parent-waits-client-EOF cycle.
